text.arabic_uthmani: سَابِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا كَعَرْضِ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أُعِدَّتْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

words.gloss_range: Form III plural imperative of competitive precedence, locally directed by the following endpoint phrase
words.root_gloss_range: precedence and outstripping range, locally active as reciprocal racing rather than generic haste
words.prose: {{ar:سَابِقُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:sābiqū}}) opens the ayah as a second-person plural Form III imperative: the audience is made to race one another toward the goal named next, not to fight an unnamed opponent. The parallel with the haste command in 3:133 shows the same forgiveness-and-garden frame sharpened here into reciprocal precedence, and the move from 57:20 turns diagnosis of near-life into a starting signal.

topics.headline: communal race toward forgiveness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah begin as a communal race command toward forgiveness, not as a neutral invitation to move quickly.
topics.reason: QAC grammar confirms a Form III plural imperative with direction supplied by the following endpoint phrase; the CRITICAL rows on reciprocal competition, 3:133, and the 57:20 boundary all support the opening-race topic.

words.gloss_range: prepositional endpoint marker governing the forgiveness noun
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}) gives the command its endpoint. Because the particle governs the following forgiveness noun, the racing image becomes movement toward a divine gift rather than generic rivalry.

topics.headline: directional endpoint for the race
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the race is immediately given a destination, so competition is morally aimed rather than open-ended.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as a preposition of direction/goal, and the CRITICAL rows converge on endpoint force and immediate narrowing of the race image.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive verbal noun for forgiveness as a pursued destination from the addressees’ Lord
words.root_gloss_range: covering and protection field, locally narrowed to moral forgiveness with protective concealment pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: endpoint preposition that makes forgiveness the race destination

words.prose: {{ar:مَغْفِرَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:maghfiratin}}) is an indefinite genitive verbal noun governed by {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}), so forgiveness becomes the race destination rather than a finite request. The {{ar:غ ف ر}} ({{tr:gh-f-r}}) covering field remains meaningful as protective concealment of fault, while local grammar keeps the selected sense as moral forgiveness; its recurrence from 57:20 turns a named afterlife option into the pursued path.

topics.headline: unbounded covering as first goal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first prize is not self-produced pardon but an unbounded Lord-sourced covering of fault.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the endpoint particle and sourced by the following Lord phrase; V4-style root evidence supports covering pressure but does not replace the local forgiveness sense.

words.gloss_range: source-marking preposition with possible scope over forgiveness alone or the paired reward complex
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) marks source in the phrase from the addressees’ Lord. The clearest local attachment sources forgiveness, while the nearby coordination leaves a broader scope over the paired reward possible; either way, the remedy is not produced by the deceptive near-life goods diagnosed in 57:20.

topics.headline: Lord-sourced reward phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the pursued forgiveness, and possibly the paired garden as well, is grammatically sourced from the Lord rather than generated by the racers.
topics.reason: QAC marks source/origin for the following Lord phrase; attachment rows permit a narrow or broader scope, so the topic is preserved with that limit.

words.gloss_range: construct noun with second-person plural suffix, naming the addressees’ Lord as source
words.root_gloss_range: authority, nurture, and bringing-to-completion range, locally narrowed to Lordship as source of forgiveness
words.prose: {{ar:رَّبِّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbikum}}) is definite through the second-person plural suffix, so the source is your Lord in direct relation to the addressed racers. The {{ar:ر ب ب}} ({{tr:r-b-b}}) field of authority and nurturing completion gives that source developmental pressure, while the local phrase keeps it as the Lord from whom forgiveness comes; same-surah Lordship echoes at 57:8 and 57:19 strengthen the thread.

topics.headline: directly possessed Lordship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the reward-source as personally addressed Lordship, authority joined to care for the racing community.
topics.reason: QAC confirms construct plus plural possessive suffix; CRITICAL semantic rows are retained as Lordship color but narrowed to the local source phrase.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction adding the garden as a second race goal
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the garden with forgiveness as a second goal of the race. The conjunction keeps the two gifts parallel and distinct: covering of fault first, then the garden named next.

topics.headline: forgiveness and garden kept distinct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees pardon and garden as paired but not collapsed into one restatement.
topics.reason: QAC and CRITICAL rows agree that the conjunction coordinates the following garden with the preceding forgiveness under the race-goal frame.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive garden coordinated as the second destination and later described by cosmic width
words.root_gloss_range: concealment and covered/protected domain range, locally narrowed to paradise garden with hiddenness pressure
words.prose: {{ar:جَنَّةٍ}} ({{tr:jannatin}}) is genitive by coordination with the forgiveness goal and remains indefinite, preparing for a description beyond ordinary specification. The {{ar:ج ن ن}} ({{tr:j-n-n}}) concealment field makes the garden a protected hidden domain, while pronoun agreement in the next word attaches the cosmic-width clause to this garden specifically, making the hidden reward also immeasurably expansive; the link with belief and greatness recalls the reward angle of 57:12.

topics.headline: hidden garden as second destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the garden as a concealed protected reward that is also made immeasurably expansive by the following width clause.
topics.reason: Grammar makes the noun a coordinated goal and the following feminine suffix points back to it; broad concealment-family rows are preserved only as pressure on the garden sense.

words.gloss_range: nominative width noun with feminine suffix, starting an embedded description of the garden
words.root_gloss_range: breadth, display, and presentation range, locally narrowed to measurable width with presentation pressure
words.prose: {{ar:عَرْضُهَا}} ({{tr:ʿarḍuhā}}) carries the garden in its suffix and becomes the subject of the embedded description. The local sense is width, but the {{ar:ع ر ض}} ({{tr:ʿ-r-ḍ}}) presentation range survives as payoff: the garden’s breadth is how its magnitude is shown; unlike 3:133, this ayah uses an explicit likeness construction.

topics.headline: the garden’s width becomes display
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the garden is not merely named; its own width becomes the clause-center that displays its magnitude.
topics.reason: QAC confirms nominative subject with suffix referring to the garden; root rows about presentation are narrowed to rhetorical display while width remains the selected local sense.

words.gloss_range: comparative preposition governing the following genitive width noun
words.prose: {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka}}) governs the next width noun and marks likeness. The garden’s width is set like the width of the sky-and-earth measure, so the comparison gives scale while preserving distinction.

topics.headline: cosmic scale as likeness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the cosmic measure is a simile of width, not a claim that the garden and cosmos are identical objects.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the preposition as establishing comparison and governing the following genitive; both CRITICAL rows support simile force.

words.gloss_range: genitive construct width noun serving as the comparandum standard
words.root_gloss_range: breadth/display range, locally used as the repeated measure attached to heaven and earth
words.prose: {{ar:عَرْضِ}} ({{tr:ʿarḍi}}) repeats the width root but shifts role: after the garden’s own width, this second width is the construct standard tied to the sky and earth. The repetition centers breadth rather than other garden imagery.

topics.headline: width repeated as measuring standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears breadth become the refrain: first the garden’s property, then the cosmic measuring standard.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as genitive after the comparison particle and in construct; CRITICAL rows on local repetition and standard-setting are directly supported.

words.gloss_range: definite singular sky/heaven in construct as the upper pole of the comparison
words.root_gloss_range: height, upperness, canopy, and naming/elevation dispute range, locally narrowed to the known upper realm
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَآءِ}} ({{tr:al-samāʾi}}) is definite and singular in the width construct, giving the comparison a known upper pole. The {{ar:س م و}} ({{tr:s-m-w}}) height and canopy sense is active locally, while the 3:133 plural-heavens parallel shows this ayah choosing singular compression rather than a layered plural expression.

topics.headline: singular known sky as upper measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this ayah compresses the upper realm into a singular known sky while using it with earth as a cosmic measure.
topics.reason: QAC confirms singular definite genitive; root-dispute rows are narrowed to elevation/upperness, and the 3:133 contrast supports the singular-plural observation.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction completing the sky-earth measurement pair
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins earth to sky inside the width standard. The conjunction turns upper and lower realms into a single measurement pair for the garden’s breadth.

topics.headline: upper and lower joined as one scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the scale become a paired cosmos measure, not sky alone.
topics.reason: QAC and CRITICAL rows agree that the conjunction coordinates earth with sky, completing the compound scale.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive earth coordinated with sky as the lower pole of the comparison
words.root_gloss_range: ground, soil, lower substrate range, locally narrowed to the known earth in the sky-earth merism
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) is the definite lower counterpart to the sky in the comparison. Its ground/substrate field supports the high-low totality, while the local grammar keeps it as the known earth; if even the garden’s width is measured by the sky-and-earth span, ordinary containment logic is strained, and the same-surah cosmic frame from 57:1, 57:2, 57:4, 57:5, 57:10, 57:17, and 57:22 is repurposed as reward measure.

topics.headline: earth as lower pole of total scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the garden-width comparison stretch across the known high-low cosmos, making ordinary containment logic inadequate.
topics.reason: QAC confirms definite genitive coordination; CRITICAL rows about merism and cosmic scale survive, but claims of physical impossibility are kept as rhetorical pressure rather than a literal cosmology.

words.gloss_range: Form IV passive perfect feminine verb, agreeing with the garden and foregrounding readiness
words.root_gloss_range: counting, numbering, and preparation range, locally narrowed to made-ready reward with allocation pressure
words.prose: {{ar:أُعِدَّتْ}} ({{tr:uʿiddat}}) is a Form IV passive perfect with feminine agreement, so the garden specifically has been made ready. The passive suppresses the preparer while context points toward God, and the {{ar:ع د د}} ({{tr:ʿ-d-d}}) counting-to-preparation field makes readiness feel allotted rather than improvised.

topics.headline: completed preparation of the garden
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees agency shift away from the racers: the garden has already been made ready, with the preparer reverently unspoken.
topics.reason: QAC confirms passive perfect feminine agreement with the garden; rows about hidden agency, Form IV readiness, and counted allocation are retained with local limits.

words.gloss_range: beneficiary/purpose preposition governing the relative-pronoun recipient phrase
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) opens the beneficiary phrase after the passive preparation. It marks the garden as for the people defined by the following relative clause, with purpose and recipient force held together.

topics.headline: prepared for designated recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the passive preparation turn toward its designated beneficiaries.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the preposition as governing the relative pronoun and marking beneficiary; CRITICAL rows add the purpose nuance without contradicting local grammar.

words.gloss_range: plural relative pronoun introducing the clause that defines the prepared-for group
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) does not name a tribe or bare category; it opens the relative clause that defines the beneficiaries by what follows. The garden is prepared for those characterized by completed belief.

topics.headline: recipients defined by belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recipients are defined by a clause of belief, not by a static social label.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as a plural relative pronoun governed by the beneficiary preposition; CRITICAL rows accurately describe the clause-defined criterion.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect plural verb naming the completed belief criterion for the prepared-for group
words.root_gloss_range: safety, security, trust, and belief range, locally narrowed to entering belief/trust in God and His messengers
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) is a Form IV perfect plural verb, so the recipient clause treats belief as an accomplished identifying act. The {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}) safety and trust field makes that belief feel like entry into trust-security rather than abstract assent alone, and the following objects route that trust through God and His messengers; the same-surah belief thread includes 57:16.

topics.headline: belief as completed trust-security
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees faith here as a completed plural qualification that carries trust-security, not as abstract assent alone.
topics.reason: QAC confirms perfect Form IV plural; root rows about security are narrowed to semantic pressure on belief, while co-occurrence rows support the God-and-messengers formula.

words.gloss_range: preposition connecting the belief verb to its governed divine object
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) links the belief verb to the divine name as its governed object. The instrumental shade can remain as relation pressure, but locally the main force is object-marking: belief is directed to God.

topics.headline: belief anchored by the preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees belief anchored to God rather than left as unobjected inward conviction.
topics.reason: QAC marks the preposition as governing the divine name and object of belief; the broader particle semantics are narrowed to the local construction.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name in genitive after the belief preposition
words.root_gloss_range: deity/worship and disputed bewildered-refuge derivation range, locally narrowed to the proper divine name
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) is governed by the belief preposition, making the named God the object of the recipient criterion. The divine-name derivation dispute adds devotion and refuge pressure without turning the proper name into a generic deity term; this first occurrence prepares the later bounty attribution and closing divine-name subject, and the final formula reappears at 57:29.

topics.headline: the named God as belief object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the belief criterion anchored in the named God, preparing the later bounty-source and closing-subject repetitions.
topics.reason: QAC confirms genitive proper noun after the preposition; derivational rows are preserved as pressure but narrowed by proper-name usage.

words.gloss_range: conjunction coordinating God’s messengers with God under the same belief frame
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) extends the same belief frame from God to His messengers. The conjunction prevents the criterion from being reduced to isolated belief in God without the sent transmission attached to Him.

topics.headline: messengers included in one belief frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees belief in God and His messengers held together as one credal object-complex.
topics.reason: QAC and CRITICAL rows agree that the conjunction coordinates the messengers with God as belief objects.

words.gloss_range: plural messengers in genitive coordination, definite by suffix referring to God
words.root_gloss_range: sending, release, and flowing range, locally narrowed to God’s sent messengers
words.prose: {{ar:رُسُلِهِۦ}} ({{tr:rusulihi}}) is plural and definite by its suffix, so the criterion includes God’s messengers collectively. The {{ar:ر س ل}} ({{tr:r-s-l}}) sending/release field supports the mission sense, and the accepted lighter reading keeps the same referent while marking a recitational pressure point; the formula is attested elsewhere, including 4:136, 57:19, and 64:8.

topics.headline: God’s plural messengers as transmitted authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the criterion reach across God’s messenger-chain, with the suffix binding the sent ones to God.
topics.reason: QAC confirms plural noun with divine suffix in coordination; qiraat rows are retained as phonetic/recitational evidence, not as a semantic replacement.

words.gloss_range: demonstrative subject gathering the preceding forgiveness-garden-preparation complex
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) gathers the forgiveness, garden, cosmic width, preparation, and recipient clause into one demonstrative subject. It pivots from description to attribution, also carrying residue from the approval option in 57:20 into the bounty statement.

topics.headline: the reward complex gathered for attribution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the whole preceding reward scene packaged into one subject before it is named as divine bounty.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the demonstrative as subject pointing back; boundary and structural rows support its packaging function.

words.gloss_range: nominative construct predicate identifying the gathered reward as God’s bounty
words.root_gloss_range: excess, surplus, preference, and overflow range, locally narrowed to divine bounty beyond wage or entitlement

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: demonstrative that gathers the preceding reward complex for attribution

words.prose: {{ar:فَضْلُ}} ({{tr:faḍlu}}) is the predicate of {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}), so the whole reward complex is identified as God’s bounty. The {{ar:ف ض ل}} ({{tr:f-ḍ-l}}) surplus field is the payoff: forgiveness, garden, and preparation are framed as overflow beyond entitlement; this same bounty-giving formula is expanded at 57:29, and the root returns in the final attribute of this ayah.

topics.headline: reward named as surplus bounty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the entire forgiveness-and-garden complex reclassified as surplus divine bounty rather than transactional payment.
topics.reason: QAC confirms the nominal predicate in construct with the divine name; root and recurrence rows support surplus-bounty framing, narrowed away from any claim that grammar alone proves theology.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name in genitive completing the bounty construct
words.root_gloss_range: deity/worship and disputed refuge derivation range, locally narrowed to the named God as bounty source and owner
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) completes the construct after the bounty noun, binding the surplus to the named God as source and owner. The divine name repeats across belief object, bounty source, and closing subject, structuring the ayah’s movement from trust in God to bounty from God to God possessing bounty.

topics.headline: bounty bound to the named God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees bounty as a relation from the named God, not an impersonal abstraction.
topics.reason: QAC confirms genitive proper noun in construct; derivational rows are preserved as semantic pressure while the local function remains source/owner in the construct.

words.gloss_range: Form IV imperfect verb with masculine object suffix referring back to bounty
words.root_gloss_range: coming and arrival range, locally active through Form IV giving as causing the bounty to arrive
words.prose: {{ar:يُؤْتِيهِ}} ({{tr:yuʾtīhi}}) carries a masculine object suffix referring back to bounty, not to the feminine garden. Its Form IV giving can be heard as causing the bounty to arrive, while the shift from completed passive preparation to active imperfect giving makes hidden readiness become ongoing divine distribution; the formula recurs with expansion at 57:29.

topics.headline: bounty delivered under divine agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that what is given is the bounty itself, delivered by God after the garden has already been prepared.
topics.reason: QAC confirms Form IV imperfect with masculine object suffix; attachment and morphology block taking the suffix as the garden, and root-arrival rows are narrowed to Form IV giving.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun opening the recipient slot in the giving clause
words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) opens the recipient slot in the giving clause. After the prepared-for believers have been named, the phrase with the following will-verb preserves divine selection rather than closing the category into a humanly controlled list.

topics.headline: whoever under divine choice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the discourse move from named believers to an open recipient slot governed by divine willing.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as a relative pronoun in the giving/willing construction; both CRITICAL rows support the open recipient slot.

words.gloss_range: imperfect will-verb with implied divine subject closing the bounty distribution clause
words.root_gloss_range: will and thingness association range, locally narrowed to operative divine volition
words.prose: {{ar:يَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:yashāʾu}}) is an imperfect verb with God as the implied subject, and it closes the giving clause. The {{ar:ش ي أ}} ({{tr:sh-y-ʾ}}) will/thing association can color the statement as determinate volition, while local grammar keeps the point simple and strong: God gives the bounty to whomever He wills, a nexus echoed at 57:29.

topics.headline: divine will closes the grant clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees distribution end under active divine will, not automatic eligibility.
topics.reason: QAC confirms imperfect verb and implied divine subject in context; speculative thingness rows are narrowed to semantic pressure, while clause-final sovereignty is directly supported.

words.gloss_range: resumptive/connective conjunction opening the final nominal clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes and connects at once, launching the final nominal clause. It links the giving statement to its ground: God is the possessor of the bounty named in the closure.

topics.headline: the final declaration launched
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the giving statement joined to a fresh grounding declaration about God’s possession of bounty.
topics.reason: QAC says the conjunction introduces the final nominal clause; CRITICAL rows coherently preserve both connective and resumptive force.

words.gloss_range: nominative proper divine name as subject of the closing nominal clause
words.root_gloss_range: deity/worship and disputed refuge derivation range, locally narrowed to the proper divine name as final grammatical center
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) is nominative as the subject of the closing nominal clause, resetting the grammatical center from the bounty and recipient back to God. The same closing formula appears at 57:29, and this final divine name answers the earlier belief-object and bounty-source occurrences in the ayah.

topics.headline: God reset as final subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah’s final grammar return from gift and recipient to God Himself as the closing subject.
topics.reason: QAC confirms nominative subject; derivational rows are narrowed to pressure on the proper name, while recurrence and formula rows support the closure function.

words.gloss_range: five-noun nominative predicate in construct with the bounty noun
words.root_gloss_range: possession/owner noun range, locally narrowed to a standing divine possessor attribute
words.prose: {{ar:ذُو}} ({{tr:dhū}}) is the nominative five-noun predicate in construct with the bounty noun. It makes possession the formal hinge of the closing clause: after God gives bounty, God is named as the enduring possessor of bounty; the phrase functions as a recognizable epithet frame also supported by 57:29.

topics.headline: standing possession through the five-noun form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees bounty stated as a standing attribute of God, not merely as an event of giving.
topics.reason: QAC confirms five-noun predicate in construct; CRITICAL rows about special declension and possession-as-attribute are supported, with identity-language kept as theological pressure rather than a new lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive bounty noun governed by the possessor construct
words.root_gloss_range: surplus, excess, and bounty range, locally totalized by the article after the possessor noun
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْفَضْلِ}} ({{tr:al-faḍli}}) is genitive after the possessor noun and definite with the article. That definiteness expands the earlier construct bounty into the category as a whole: the specific forgiveness-and-garden gift is grounded in God’s possession of total bounty.

topics.headline: from specific gift to total bounty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah move from this bounty of God to the whole category of bounty God possesses.
topics.reason: QAC confirms genitive complement of the construct; rows about progression from construct bounty to definite total bounty are locally supported.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive qualitative adjective agreeing with the bounty noun and closing the ayah
words.root_gloss_range: greatness, magnitude, and structural-core imagery range, locally narrowed to stable greatness of the bounty
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَظِيمِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿaẓīmi}}) agrees with the bounty noun in definiteness and genitive case, so greatness belongs specifically to the bounty. The {{ar:ع ظ م}} ({{tr:ʿ-ẓ-m}}) structural-greatness image is narrowed to stable qualitative magnitude, and as the final word it seals the ayah on immensity after the sky-earth width and bounty repetition; same-surah reward language includes 57:12 and the closing formula at 57:29.

topics.headline: great bounty as final landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah land on the magnitude of the bounty itself, matching the earlier cosmic-width scale.
topics.reason: QAC confirms adjective agreement; root imagery and cadence rows are preserved as pressure on the final qualitative seal, not as separate lexical activation.

baseline_models.mechanism: A plural race imperative directs deliberate precedence toward a two-stage destination: protection from sin's effect and then an already-prepared, cosmically broad garden.

activation_trace.role: Advancing and racing supplies urgency and directed precedence.
Covering sin and protecting its bearer makes forgiveness the first protective destination.
A garden hidden by dense trees supplies the second inhabitable destination.
Breadth rather than length makes the destination expansive rather than a narrow prize.
Prepared provision makes the destination ready before the runners arrive.

changed_reading.before: An exhortation to seek forgiveness and Paradise.
changed_reading.after: A time-sensitive collective advance toward protection and an already-ready destination whose breadth removes any implication of scarcity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: سَابِقُوا ... ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَاءُ
baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative supplies human agency, but repeated favor, giving, and will refuse a wage-for-speed equation; the race is responsive initiative inside donated abundance.

activation_trace.role: Racing supplies real initiative without itself defining ownership of the result.
Heart-settling assent identifies the recipients by trust rather than finishing rank.
Unowed beneficence frames the whole destination as gift.
Giving assigns transfer from giver to recipient, not capture by a victor.
Divine willing governs the particular grant and blocks a mechanical merit calculus.

changed_reading.before: The fastest believer earns the largest reward.
changed_reading.after: All are pressed to initiate, while forgiveness and garden remain unowed favor rather than a prize captured from rivals.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier comparison of the same costly acts before and after an opening gives precedence a concrete opportunity structure: racing is acting while the cost is still high, not merely moving faster than another person.

activation_trace.role: The focus race receives the temporal and costly specification supplied by 57:10.
Money leaving its holder makes precedence materially costly rather than rhetorical.
Temporal priorness distinguishes initiative before conditions change.
An opening of victory marks the boundary after which the same act is easier and differently ranked.
Degree-by-degree ranking preserves a difference created by timely initiative.

structural_cues: 57:10 contrasts spending and fighting before the opening with the same acts after it, yet promises both groups good.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal asymmetry, costly acts, unequal degree, and an inclusive promise; I infer that 57:21's race is early initiative before conditions ease, while generic moral haste remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: Race means simply doing good quickly.
changed_reading.after: Race means absorbing cost before an opening makes action easier; precedence changes degree without cancelling the promise to later actors.

context_deltas.mechanism: The eschatological scene transfers motion from the believers to their light: directed movement runs before them, reaches the garden announcement, and is answered by rivers that continue to flow.

activation_trace.role: The commanded race supplies the present directed motion that the context reframes.
Purposeful motion toward a sought end is predicated of the believers' light.
Illumination becomes the moving guide that precedes its bearers.
The same tree-covered garden root resolves the race's destination in the later scene.
Continuous flowing under the gardens converts sprinting into an enduring current at arrival.

structural_cues: 57:12 keeps the same believers, places their light moving before them, and immediately announces gardens with flowing rivers as the great triumph.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel motion and the same garden destination; I align present racing with the later forward-running light, while the live alternative is that 57:12 is an independent afterlife tableau rather than an effect of the race.

changed_reading.before: Believers run toward a static garden.
changed_reading.after: Their present directed striving is mirrored by a light that runs ahead of them into the announced garden; the race leaves an advance path-marker rather than ending in mere speed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Urgency now answers a degrading temporal process: the due moment arrives, a prolonged interval hardens hearts, and divine revivification can turn dead ground back into living growth.

activation_trace.role: Racing becomes a response to the temporal danger disclosed just before the focus.
Dense, surging vegetation lets the garden receive the context's revived-earth image.
Arrival at the due moment makes delay morally consequential.
An extended endpoint supplies the interval across which responsiveness degrades.
Loss of the heart's softness names the process that urgency must outrun.
Earth made alive by rain and vegetation supplies the reversal of hardening.
Dead land supplies the apparently exhausted state from which revival begins.

structural_cues: The question 'has the time not come?' is followed by a warning that a long interval hardens hearts, then by dead earth being revived.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies due time, hardening, and revived earth; I infer that the race counters delayed receptivity and that the garden maps revival onto the heart, while a purely eschatological resurrection analogy remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Race is haste only because the reward is desirable.
changed_reading.after: Race is haste against a process: delay can harden the receptive heart, yet the Lord can revive dead ground into garden-like life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah presents a rival race of boasting and numerical outdoing whose attractive crop becomes debris; the focus redirects competitive energy toward covering, approval, and a prepared garden beyond that decay cycle.

activation_trace.role: The explicit race verb receives and redirects the competitive force of 57:20.
The prepared tree-covered garden opposes the crop that collapses into debris.
Mutual boasting supplies one false arena of competition.
Trying to outnumber others supplies the rival race's measurable scoreboard.
The world's vanishing debris supplies the terminal state of that scoreboard.
Protective forgiveness is already named as the alternative immediately before the command.
Abundant divine approval replaces peer admiration as the sought evaluation.

structural_cues: 57:20 moves from play, distraction, adornment, boasting, and accumulation through crop growth, yellowing, and debris, then contrasts punishment with forgiveness and approval immediately before 57:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, two competitive social forms, a decay sequence, and the alternative pair; I infer deliberate rerouting of competitive desire, while simple dunya-versus-akhira contrast remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: Racing is a neutral increase in religious speed.
changed_reading.after: The command converts an existing urge to outdo others: leave the contest of accumulation that ends as debris and compete toward what protects and does not decay.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prepared destination is set beside events fixed before their creation and an affective discipline toward what escapes or is given; racing therefore becomes urgent action without the fantasy that the runner authors or owns outcomes.

activation_trace.role: The imperative preserves urgency inside the context's non-controlling posture.
An already-prepared garden supplies anterior readiness on the destination side.
A fixed inscription supplies anterior determination on the event side.
Creation marks the point before which events are already inscribed.
Failure to reach what has escaped names the loss that must not govern the runner.
Exultant self-inflation names the opposite distortion when gains arrive.
What arrives is explicitly given, supporting receipt rather than self-authored possession.

structural_cues: 57:22 places affliction in a book before its creation; 57:23 states the purpose as neither grieving over what escapes nor exulting over what is given, and rejects boastful self-display.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preparation, prior inscription, creation, missed outcomes, and given outcomes; I infer a shared anteriority that changes the runner's posture, while the verses may instead offer separate consolation after the race command.

changed_reading.before: Race requires anxiety about falling behind and elation at gains.
changed_reading.after: Race is urgent but non-possessive: act within a field not authored by the runner, neither shattered by what escapes nor inflated by what is given.

context_deltas.mechanism: A self-created ascetic practice sought approval but was not maintained; the following address instead joins trust in the messenger to granted light for walking and forgiveness. Racing is thus accelerated fidelity on a supplied route, not maximal novelty.

activation_trace.role: The race imperative poses the question of what kind of accelerated practice is authorized.
Creation without a prior model supplies the rejected equation of speed with devotional novelty.
Seeking divine approval preserves the practice's sincere aim despite its invented form.
Attentive maintenance supplies the durability test the invented practice failed.
The message-bearer marks the supplied route immediately after the failed innovation.
Granted illumination makes continued movement possible without inventing the path.
Ordinary walking tempers the focus sprint with sustainable movement.
The focus destination recurs as promised forgiveness at the end of the guided route.

structural_cues: 57:27 says the ascetic practice was invented, not prescribed, sought approval, and was not maintained rightly; 57:28 then commands faith in the messenger and promises light to walk by and forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies juxtaposed failed innovation and guided walking; I infer that 57:28 corrects the mode of pursuit relevant to 57:21, while a merely historical sequence with no corrective force remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Race authorizes ever more extreme devotional innovation.
changed_reading.after: Race is accelerated fidelity on a messenger-marked route, tested by whether practice can be rightly maintained; grace supplies light even for ordinary walking.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing ayah repeats the focus's favor-giving-will refrain but first denies a named community control over any of that favor and places it in God's owning hand. The race can mobilize action but cannot privatize its end.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies the commanded initiative whose limits the closing refrain clarifies.
Communal belonging names the affiliation that does not confer control of favor.
Negated effective capacity blocks communal command over even one portion of favor.
Threefold unowed beneficence repeats and expands the focus's gift frame.
The owning hand locates control of the favor outside every competing group.
Giving repeats the transfer logic of the focus rather than an earning transaction.
The occurrence set joins any object of favor to the will governing its grant.

structural_cues: 57:29 repeats 57:21's favor-giving-will-favor-great closure, but introduces it by denying the People of the Book control over any favor and locating favor in God's hand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the near-verbatim refrain plus denied capacity and the owning hand; I infer that the repetition interprets the focus race as non-appropriative, while a general reaffirmation of generosity remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Race lets a believing group secure or monopolize the favor.
changed_reading.after: Race cannot turn favor into communal property or controllable capital: initiative is commanded, but the gift remains in the owning hand that gives.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the garden through the wall scene rather than identifying an explicit garden there; it remains anchored in forgiveness-as-protective-covering and garden-as-shield plus the context's wall, gate, interior, and mercy. Render only as a spatial analogy, never as a claim that the garden simply is the wall.

activation_trace.role: Protective covering gives the destination an enclosing function.
A shielding enclosure makes the garden legible as protection as well as vegetation.
A high surrounding wall supplies the separating enclosure.
An entrance makes access to the protected side threshold-dependent.
The inside of a thing locates the protected zone spatially.
Merciful tenderness identifies the quality of the interior side.

changed_reading.before: The garden is only an open botanical reward.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, forgiveness and garden form a protected interior reached through a timely threshold, with mercy inside and destructive exposure outside.

strongest_changes: Precedence becomes costly early initiative before an opening, not exclusionary speed.
The command redirects the worldly contests of boasting and accumulation away from a crop that ends as debris.
Prepared destination and prior inscription produce urgency without possession anxiety over what escapes or arrives.
The exact closing refrain denies any community control of favor even while the focus commands everyone to race.
summary.what_was_special: Motion repeatedly changes form around the focus: costly action precedes an opening, light runs ahead, dead earth revives, ordinary walking follows granted light, and throughout the destination remains prepared gift rather than capturable prize.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the forward-running light is caused by present racing or is only an analogous later motion.
Whether 57:27-28 deliberately corrects misreadings of racing or simply continues a historical sequence.
The protected-interior reading is a contained spatial analogy, not an explicit identification.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Racing redirects competitive energy toward protective covering.** س ب ق B001 is preceding and racing ahead; غ ف ر B001 is protective covering and B002 shielding from consequence. This imperative follows 57:20’s rivalry in abundance. The packet supplies one competition followed by another; I infer competitive drive can be redirected -> race for a covering rather than display. **سابقوا** corrects the object of competition without erasing urgency.
2. **Breadth removes the scarcity logic of worldly rivalry.** ع ر ض B001 is side-breadth; the same word is repeated in the comparison to sky and earth. ف ض ل B003 is beneficence and bounty, while B001 is excess and remainder. The packet supplies immense breadth and repeated bounty; I infer non-scarce provision -> another’s arrival does not reduce one’s share. The race is therefore not a zero-sum contest.
3. **Preparation precedes reception.** ع د د B002 is preparing what is readied. The passive **أعدت** is followed by a gift formula in which فضل is given. The packet supplies prior preparation and later giving; I infer reception enters an already made capacity. The garden reads as prepared bounty rather than a space generated by human competition.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 57:29 repeats فضل three times and locates it in God’s hand, confirming the non-scarcity correction. It also denies inherited communities control over any portion of that bounty.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Competition redirected and deprived of superiority claims.** `س ب ق` **B001** supplies racing ahead; `ف ض ل` **B004** supplies claiming superiority, while **B003** supplies bounty given from surplus. The preceding 57:20 has rivalry in abundance, and 57:23–24 develop boastful self-image and withholding. The packet supplies the competitive impulse and then names the destination a grant; I infer that the race redirects rivalry while bounty prevents the winner from claiming authorship. The imperative reads as transformed competition, not continuation of social ranking under a sacred object.
2. **An expansive double cover answers scarcity.** `غ ف ر` **B001** supplies protective covering, `ج ن ن` **B003/B008** a tree-covered and protective enclosure, and repeated `ع ر ض` **B001** lateral breadth. The world's narrowing competition in 57:20 is answered by a cover as broad as sky and earth; affliction in 57:22 supplies what requires protection. I infer that breadth removes the scarcity premise that drives mutual boasting. Forgiveness and garden thus form layered, cosmos-wide shelter rather than two disconnected rewards.
3. **Human racing enters a provision prepared in advance.** `ع د د` **B002** supplies preparing what will be needed, `ء ت ي` **B002** granting, and the “willing” variant of merged `ش ي ء` **B001** supplies volition in *yashāʾ*. The next ayah places events in a book before they are brought into being, while 57:25–26 place book and prophetic provision into human history. The packet supplies prior preparation and subsequent grant; I infer that racing responds to a prepared field rather than producing it. The ayah therefore keeps urgency inside prior generosity.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 57:22's book-before-creation made “prepared” in this ayah part of a wider prior-ordering pattern. More importantly, 57:23–24 blocked a triumphalist reading of the race: exultant superiority and withholding are precisely what `ف ض ل` **B004** must not turn the granted bounty into.

baseline.text: Rabbinizden bir bağışlanmaya ve genişliği gökle yerin genişliği gibi olan bir bahçeye ulaşmak için yarışın. O, Allah'a ve elçilerine inananlar için hazırlanmıştır. Bu Allah'ın lütfudur; onu dilediğine verir. Allah büyük lütuf sahibidir.

findings.text: Bağışlanmaya doğru yarış, önceki çoğalma rekabetinin enerjisini başka bir hedefe çevirir; varılacak şey Allah'ın lütfu olduğu için yarış üstünlük ve sahiplik iddiası üretmez.
Bağışlanma ile gök ve yer genişliğindeki bahçe, kıtlık korkusuna karşı üst üste gelen, başkasının payıyla daralmayan geniş bir koruma alanı kurar.
İnsanların yarışı bahçeyi üretmez; yarışanlar, kendilerinden önce hazırlanmış ve Allah'ın iradesiyle verilen bir imkan alanına girer.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Covering changes moral function according to what it does to its object: it can obstruct truth, incubate life, or shield a person by effacing offense.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The disbelief root can name both obstructive covering and a farmer's productive covering of seed, while an atoning branch reverses concealment into protection.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Covering Protects the Offender
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A protective layer is placed over offense and offender, effacing exposure and keeping the person within a guarded boundary.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: a cover that protects `quranic:root_001096:B001/m01`; covering a sin and protecting its bearer `quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`; effacing an offense by covering it `quranic:root_001307:B009/m01`; protective barrier `quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Forgiveness is pictured as shelter rather than denial of what occurred. The latent atoning branch of the disbelief root turns the cover around: instead of blocking truth from the person, it blocks the offense from destroying the person.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı, yürüyüşte, koşuda ya da bir işte başkasının önüne geçme ve karşılıklı yarışarak öne çıkma ekseninde kurar. Geçici dal çerçevesi bunu doğru yakalar; yalnız yarışta konan pay, avcı kuş bağı ve takipten kaçıp kurtulma anlamları bu dalın çekirdeğine alınmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hem yalın öne geçmeyi hem yarış yapısını kapsar; ödül payı, kuş bağı ve kaçıp kurtulma ayrı sınırlardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın öne geçme anlamını korur ve yarış, kapıya atılma ya da belirli yoldan aşma gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımları onunla karıştırmadan ayrı bağlamlarda gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin, hayvanın ya da işin hareket, koşu veya girişim içinde başkasından önce gelmesini ve yarışma yoluyla ön alma çabasını anlatır. Çekirdek, öne geçme ilişkisi iken karşılıklı yarışma bu çekirdeğin yapıya bağlı bir gerçekleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, hareket, koşu ya da bir işte başkasından önce gelme ve önde bulunma ilişkisidir.
Koşuda veya benzeri bir karşılaşmada iki tarafın birbirini geçmeye çalışması yarışma yüzünü oluşturur.
Bir şeye önce davranma ya da bir işe başkalarından önce atılma, hareket çekirdeğinin iş ve girişim alanına taşınmasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların birleşik çerçevesi, öne geçme ve önce gelme çekirdeğini yürüyüş, koşu ve iş alanlarına uygular. Yarışma kullanımı, iki tarafın aynı hedefte öne geçmeye çalışması olarak bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı, yarış veya atış ortamında taraflar arasında önceden ortaya konan ve öne geçenin aldığı pay, rehin ya da risk nesnesi olarak tanımlar. Bu yüzden dal yarışma eylemi değil, yarışmaya bağlanan kazanç payıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnız ortaya konan payı kapsar; öne geçme eylemi, yarışın kendisi ve avcı kuş bağı ayrı tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın ad değerini pay veya rehin nesnesi olarak verir; kazanma, alma ya da verme kalıplarını bu nesneye bağlı kullanımlar olarak sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Yarış, atış ya da at yarışı gibi bir karşılaşmada ortaya konan ve öne geçen tarafın aldığı payı anlatır. Çekirdek, yarışmanın kendisi değil, kazanan için belirlenmiş nesne veya kazanç payıdır.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, yarış veya atış tarafları arasında ortaya konan kazanç payı ya da rehin nesnesidir.
Bu pay, öne geçen ya da kazanan tarafın alacağı şey olarak belirlenir.
Atış ve at yarışı gibi düzenli karşılaşmalar, payın konduğu tipik alanlardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, dalı yarışma ortamına konan pay veya rehin olarak verir. Bu payın belirleyici özelliği, karşılaşmada öne geçen tarafça alınmasıdır; yarış eylemiyle karıştırılmamalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı, avcı kuşun ayaklarına takılan iki bağ veya kısıt olarak tanımlar ve bunları kuşun ayaklarına takma eylemini de aynı teknik kullanımda verir. Bu çerçeve, öne geçme ya da yarış payı anlamlarından ayrı özel bir araç adıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız avcı kuşun ayak bağlarını ve bunları takmayı kapsar; genel yarış, yarış payı ve takipten kaçma anlamları dışarıdadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, iki ayak bağı adını çekirdek alır; kuşa bu bağları takma kalıbını aynı teknik nesneye bağlı kullanım olarak sınırlar.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, avcı kuşun ayaklarındaki kayış, sicim veya benzeri malzemeden iki bağdır.
Bu iki bağı kuşun ayaklarına takma eylemi, nesne adına bağlı teknik kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, dalı avcı kuşun ayaklarını tutan iki bağ olarak verir. Malzeme kayış, sicim veya benzeri olabilir; takma eylemi de aynı araçla sınırlıdır.

error_profile.loses: Öne geçerek erişimi aşma görüntüsünü ve olumsuz örneklerdeki aciz bırakamama vurgusunu açıkça vermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir takipçinin, yakalamak istediği kişiye veya şeye yetişemediği bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Takip edenin erişememesi ve aranan tarafın kurtulması ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Olumsuz örneklerde takip edenin hedefi elden kaçırmadığını ya da ona yetişebildiğini açıklamak için ters yönden kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Takip edenin erişim sınırını ve yakalama ilişkisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Takip edilen tarafın etkin biçimde kaçıp kurtulması ve öne geçmesi yönünü tek başına taşımaz.

error_profile.preserves: Bir tarafın diğerinden ileri düşmesi görüntüsünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Takipten kurtulma, yakalanmama ve takip edeni aciz bırakma sonucunu kaybeder.
error_profile.collision: Genel öne geçme ve yarışma dalıyla karışır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir tarafın üstün gelmesi düşüncesini kısmen çağrıştırır.
error_profile.loses: Takip ilişkisini ve erişimden kaçıp kurtulma sonucunu karşılamaz.
error_profile.adds: Karşılaşmada galip gelme anlamını dalın yerine koyar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, kaçıp kurtulmayı öne geçme ve takip edenin erişimini aşma görüntüsüyle kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, yetişememe, aciz kalma ve bazen güvenli yere yönelme gibi daha geniş kaçış ilişkilerini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da takip edenin hedefe yetişememesi ve hedefin kaçıp kurtulması alanını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın sınırı, takip edileni önde düşünerek erişimden çıkma sonucuna bağlanır. Komşu dal aynı sonuca yakın dursa da aciz bırakma ve kaçış alanını daha geniş bir kökten kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kaçışın takip edeni aşma ve yakalanmama sonucu olarak anlaşılmasını ister.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, genel kaçma ve uzaklaşma eylemini sonuçtan bağımsız anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da tehlikeden veya takipten uzaklaşma sahasına girer.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda sırf kaçma hareketi yetmez; takip edenin erişememesi ve hedefin kurtulması gerekir. Komşu dal daha genel kaçış fiilini anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal takipçiden kurtulma sonucunu taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal hızlı koşma, kaçma, yenilgi halinde uzaklaşma ve hayvan koşusu gibi hareket biçimlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da uzaklaşma, koşma ve takip sahnesi düşünülebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hareket biçiminden çok yakalanmama sonucuna odaklanır. Komşu dal koşma veya kaçma biçimini genişçe anlatır ve kurtuluş sonucunu zorunlu kılmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal takip edilenin erişimden kurtulmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal geri çekilme, gecikme, kaçma ve manevra yapma yönlerini de içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kaçış ve takipten sıyrılma alanında temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda kaçışın sonucu yakalanmamaktır. Komşu dal geri durma veya manevra gibi hareket tarzlarını da kapsadığı için anlam çekirdeği aynı değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal takipten kurtulma ve takip edeni yetişemez bırakma sonucunu ister.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yarışma, önce gelme ve işte başkasının önüne geçme anlamlarını takip ilişkisi olmadan taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da bir tarafın diğerinden öne düşmesi düşünülebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal öne düşmeyi yakalanmama sonucuna bağlar. Komşu dal için önde gelmek veya yarışmak yeterlidir; kaçış ve takip zorunlu değildir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; seçilenler kaçıp kurtulmayı genel kaçıştan, koşarak uzaklaşmadan ve yalın öne geçmeden ayıran adaylardır.

source_note.MU: Tek kaynaklı kanıt, anlamı özellikle kaçıp kurtulamama ve takip edeni aciz bırakamama örnekleriyle gösterir.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök ailesi öne geçme ve yarışma çekirdeğinden yarışta konan paya ve takipten kurtulma sonucuna uzanır; avcı kuşun ayak bağları ise ayrı teknik ad olarak durur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi örtmeyi, örtülen şeyi kirden ya da zarardan korumayı ve başlık, bez, bulut, kap ile ilgili özel gerçekleşmeleri birlikte destekler. Bu nedenle dalın koruyarak örtme çerçevesi kaynak anlamını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği fiziksel ya da işlevsel örtme ve korumadır; suçun bağışlanması, hastalığın kötüleşmesi ve öteki eş adlı anlamlar buna katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak örtme çekirdeği ile başlık, bez, bulut ve belirli söz öbeklerine bağlı kullanımlar ayrı tutulur; özel kullanımlar bütün dala yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi örterek görünürlükten, kirden ya da zarardan korumak ve bu işi gören örtü veya koruyucu katmanı belirtmektir. Bazı kullanımlar, eşyayı kaba koyma ya da bir işi gereken biçimde örtüp düzeltme gibi belirli yapılara bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir şeyi örterek onu dış etkiden korumak ya da görünmez kılmaktır.
Başı koruyan zırh başlığı, başörtüsünü yağdan sakınan bez, yay çentiğindeki yama ve başka bir bulutu örten bulut bu çekirdeğin özel örnekleridir.
Eşyayı bir kaba koyma, kumaşı kiri daha iyi gizler duruma getirme ve bir işi uygun biçimde örtüp düzeltme yalnızca belirtilen yapılarda geçerlidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar örtme ile korumayı ortak çekirdek sayar; koruyucu başlık ve çeşitli bez ya da örtü türleri bu çekirdeği somutlaştırırken kap, kumaş ve iş düzenleme kullanımları belirli yapılara bağlı kalır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Örtme işlemi ile örtülen şeyi koruma sonucunun birlikte bulunduğu genel çekirdek için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem örtme işlemini hem de kir, zarar veya görünürlük karşısındaki koruyucu işlevi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin üstünü kapatma eyleminin aynı zamanda onu koruduğu fiil bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Çekirdekteki örtme işlemini ve bunun koruyucu sonucunu birlikte verir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Baş, kumaş, yay çentiği ya da benzeri bir yüzey üstündeki koruyucu nesne anlatılırken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Örtünün koruma işlevini ve üstte duran katman olmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Eylem anlamını ve yalnızca belirli söz yapılarında görülen kap ya da düzeltme kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Örtmenin nesneyi kirden ya da zarardan koruma amacı ve belirli koruyucu nesneleri öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin üstüne konan her türlü örtüyü, koruma sonucu zorunlu olmadan daha geniş biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyi üstten kapatma işlemini veya bu işi gören örtüyü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalında örtme ile koruyup sakınma bağı kurucudur; komşu dalda ise üstünü kapatma yeterlidir ve koruyucu sonuç zorunlu değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Koruyucu başlık, bez ve benzeri araçlarda örtmenin nesneyi korumasını özellikle içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Duyudan gizlenmeyi, kişinin bir şeyle saklanmasını ve içte saklanan düşünceyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın ortak alanı bir şeyi görünürlükten çıkaran örtme işlemidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı koruyan bir örtüyü ve koruma sonucunu öne çıkarır; komşu dal gizlenme ve içte saklama yönünde daha geniştir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Somut ya da işlevsel bir örtüyle nesneyi kirden, zarardan veya görünürlükten korur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir suçu bağışlayıp kişiyi cezanın etkisinden koruyan ahlaki ve dinsel işlemi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da olumsuz bir etkinin kişiye ya da nesneye ulaşmasını önleme düşüncesi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalının çekirdeği örtme eylemidir; komşu dalda konu suç ve cezadır, fiziksel bir örtü kurucu anlam taşımaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel örtme, gizlenme ve suçtan koruma ile en kolay karışabilecek üç sınır yayımlandı, yalnızca ortak senaryo taşıyan öteki dallar elendi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أصل الستر والتغطية والصون، وما يغطي الرأس أو الخمار أو الوتر أو السحاب، وجعل المتاع في وعاء أو جعل الثوب أحمل للوسخ.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الغفر الستر (maqayis)؛ أصل الغفر التغطية (ayn)؛ الغفر: التغطية (sihah)؛ الغفر: إلباس ما يصونه عن الدنس (mufradat)؛ المغفر وقاية للرأس (ayn)؛ المغفر: زرد ينسج من الدروع على قدر الرأس (sihah)؛ اغفروا هذا الأمر بغفرته أي استروه بما يجب أن يستر به (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir suçu bağışlama ile kişiyi cezanın dokunuşundan koruma sonuçlarını açıkça bir araya getirir; ayrıca bağışlanma istemeyi ve çok bağışlayan niteliğini aynı anlam ailesinde gösterir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu katmanları doğru sınırlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal suç, bağışlama ve cezadan korunma alanındadır; fiziksel örtüler, yüzey tüyü ve öteki eş adlı anlamlar dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bağışlama çekirdeği ile bağışlanma isteme, çok bağışlayan niteliği ve belirli cümle kalıpları ayrıştırılır; kalıba bağlı anlamlar çekirdeği genişletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir suçu bağışlayarak kişiyi o suçun cezasından korumaktır. İlgili türevler bağışlanma istemeyi ve çok bağışlayan olma niteliğini de belirtir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, işlenmiş bir suçu bağışlamaktır.
Bağışlamanın sonucu, suç işleyeni cezanın ona ulaşmasından korumaktır.
Aynı anlam ailesi bağışlanma istemeyi ve çok bağışlayan olma niteliğini de kapsar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar suçu bağışlamayı ortak çekirdek olarak verir ve bu işlemin kişiyi cezadan koruyan sonucunu belirtir; isteme biçimleri ile çok bağışlayan niteliği bu çekirdeğin türevleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Suçun bağışlanması ile suç işleyenin ceza etkisinden korunmasını birlikte anlatan tam çekirdek için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem suça yönelik bağışlama işlemini hem de kişiye yönelik cezadan koruma sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin suçunun artık ona karşı tutulmadığı doğal fiil bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Suçu kaldırma ve suç işleyene karşı bağışlayıcı davranma işlemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Cezanın kişiye ulaşmasını önleyen koruma sonucu tek başına bu sözde açık değildir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağışlamanın kişiyi cezanın etkisinden koruyan sonucu özellikle açıklanmak istendiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin cezanın dokunuşundan korunması sonucunu açıkça korur.
error_profile.loses: Korumanın öncesindeki suçu bağışlama ya da silme işlemini tek başına belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Suçun bağışlanmasını ve suç işleyenin ceza etkisinden korunmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gerekçe sunmayı, özür dilemeyi ve sunulan gerekçenin kabul edilmesini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir yanlışın ardından kişiye karşı olumsuz tepkinin kaldırılabildiği durumda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Özür ya da gerekçe bağışlamaya yol açabilir fakat bağışlama değildir; odak dalı suçun kaldırılması ve cezadan korunma sonucunu gerektirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ahlaki ya da dinsel bir suçun bağışlanmasını ve kişiye ceza ulaşmamasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir nesneyi somut veya işlevsel bir örtüyle kirden, zarardan ya da görünürlükten korur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da istenmeyen bir etkinin hedefe ulaşmasını önleyen koruma düşüncesi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalında suç ve ceza ilişkisi kurucudur; komşu dalda ise örtme eylemi ve örtünün koruyucu işlevi kurucudur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İşlenmiş suçun bağışlanmasını ve suç işleyenin cezadan korunmasını belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yanlış davranışın kendisini, onun kasıtlı oluşunu ve kişinin bu davranışla suçlu duruma gelmesini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı suç ve sorumluluk senaryosunun farklı aşamalarında yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal bağışlanacak eylemi adlandırır; odak dalı ise o eylemden sonra uygulanan bağışlama ve koruma işlemini adlandırır.
